title: Event share, placement, host transfer and co-host notices ride the notification router

source.ref: Meta scan 2026-10-26 (audits/meta-scan-2026-10-26.md), Phase 4 follow-up: remaining direct bell inserts

detail: Six direct bell inserts across the event share, placement, host-transfer and co-host actions ignored the member's notification settings. They now route one registry row, event.notice (events, in-app), through lib/notifications/event-notice.ts, so each recipient's own inapp_events switch, suppression and the outbox retry apply. Bell rows are unchanged (same type, event reference, body). The Events in-app switch in settings is now real: WIRED_PREFERENCE_CHANNELS lists events as email, push and in-app, and the pinned hidden-set test in lib/notifications/wired.test.ts moves from eight hidden to seven with the owner's go-ahead. Friend requests, billing receipts and similar always-on notices are left as direct inserts on purpose: they have no category.

verify.note: Exits 0 once the share and placement notices go through the router and no longer insert bell rows themselves.
